The orange shell is drawn at the level where H = H_min for the chosen I₁; the card is detected inside it (flat card; tilt shrinks the effective field by cos θ). 1.5 A/m is only the ISO guaranteed-operation worst case; real cards typically respond at 0.3–1 A/m, and the resonant antenna current is Q-amplified above the driver current, which is why an uncalibrated model under-predicts range.
